feeds.what: pointer to the current election's manifest
feeds.notes: {"manifestUrl": "data/v2/elections/2a6d1aef-f8eb-424f-9130-ac9bdc2cced5/manifest.json", "schemaVersion": 1}. manifestUrl is relative to the site root. Last-Modified 2026-10-28, so it changes per election, not per count.

feeds.what: manifest: the release number, generation time, and the content-addressed paths of the overview, every contest's county breakdown, and turnout
feeds.notes: Fields: schemaVersion 2, kind 'Manifest', electionId, releaseId, sequence (63 when fetched), generatedAtUtc, overview {path, sha256, bytes}, contests [{contestId, results {path, sha256, bytes}}] (372 entries), turnout {path, sha256, bytes}. Paths are relative to the manifest's folder and named by the SHA-256 of the content, so they change whenever the content changes: always re-read the manifest first. Served with Cache-Control: no-cache, ETag and Last-Modified.

feeds.what: every contest of the election in one document, with choices and race-wide totals
feeds.notes: kind 'ElectionOverview': election {id, name '2026 General Election', type, electionDate, resultsStatus 'Unofficial'}, groups, counties (17, codes 01-17), parties, contests (372). Each contest: id, name, groupId, kind (Office | Question), scope {level, label, countyCodes}, voteFor, question {identifier, summary}, choices [{id, label, kind, candidate {lastName, firstName, partyId, incumbent...}}], totals {totalVotes, expectedCountyCount, receivedCountyCount, completeCountyCount, choices [{choiceId, votes, receivedCountyCount}], lead {status, choiceIds, marginVotes}}. 89 KB gzipped on the wire. THIS URL IS ONLY VALID FOR RELEASE 63; get the current one from manifest.overview.path.
kind 'ContestResults': counties [{countyCode, choices [{choiceId, votes}], lead}]. Path comes from manifest.contests[] by contestId.
kind 'Turnout': counties [{countyCode, activeRegisteredVoters, totalTurnout, methods {electionDay, early, absentee, mail}}].

election_id: 2a6d1aef-f8eb-424f-9130-ac9bdc2cced5 (a UUID), in the path /data/v2/elections/<electionId>/ and as electionId in every document.
discovery: GET https://silverstateelection.nv.gov/results-config.json and follow manifestUrl. That file is the site's own pointer to the current election, so a future election needs no code change. I found no list of past elections.
cors: none (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin on results-config.json, the manifest or the objects)
bot_blocking: Imperva (Incapsula) in front, 'X-CDN: Imperva'. The HTML page https://silverstateelection.nv.gov/ answered the relay User-Agent and a desktop Chrome UA from curl with a 200 that is only the Incapsula JavaScript challenge (212 and 1031 bytes), and showed headless Chrome an hCaptcha. But the JSON files (results-config.json, manifest.json, objects/*.json) answered the relay User-Agent with HTTP 200 and real data, no challenge, on five requests. Imperva sets visid_incap/incap_ses cookies on those responses; I did not send them back.
updated_field: manifest.generatedAtUtc, e.g. '2026-11-10T22:21:36.5813185Z' (UTC; = 2:21 PM PST), plus manifest.sequence (63) and releaseId. The HTTP Last-Modified on the manifest was 'Tue, 10 Nov 2026 22:22:26 GMT'.
reporting_field: Counties, not precincts: contest.totals.expectedCountyCount, receivedCountyCount and completeCountyCount, e.g. Governor {"expectedCountyCount": 17, "receivedCountyCount": 17, "completeCountyCount": 17}; each choice also has receivedCountyCount.

other_statewide: Justice of the Supreme Court, Seat B

choice_format: choice.label is 'Last, First', party is by reference: {"id":"56260403-...","label":"Buck, Carrie Ann","kind":"Candidate","ballotOrder":1,"colorKey":"red","candidate":{"displayName":"Buck, Carrie","lastName":"Buck","firstName":"Carrie",...,"partyId":"party-060aaf24f0cd822ba1e86e8af66acf73","incumbent":false}}, with parties[] in the overview mapping that id to {"label":"Republican","abbreviation":"REP"} (also DEM, IAP, NP, LPN, NPP). Votes are in totals.choices[] keyed by choiceId, not on the choice itself. Nevada's 'None of These Candidates' is a choice with candidate null. Measures: kind 'Question', choices labelled 'Yes' and 'No' with kind 'Response', and question.summary holding the text.
district_field: In the title ('State Assembly, District 1') and in scope.label ('Assembly District 1', 'Congressional District 1', 'Senate District 2'), with scope.level 'District' or 'Statewide'. There is no bare numeric district field; the chamber is the group (groupId -> groups[].label 'State Senate', 'State Assembly', 'U.S. Congress', 'Statewide', 'Ballot Questions').
terms: none found (the HTML site, where terms would be, could not be read past the Imperva challenge).
